issues.description: Attribute 'lectureName' has conflicting types between the problem statement UML and the reference implementation. In problem_statement.md (UML) the attribute is declared as 'lectureName: int' (line 64). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the field is declared as 'private String lectureName;' (line 6). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about the intended type (the rest of the specification and examples use string values like "Introduction to Programming").
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as a String (e.g. 'lectureName: String') and, if present, adjust the example to clearly show a string lecture name. This aligns the specification with the reference implementation and the textual examples.
